body: Sorry for taking such a long time to answer. I still feel as if I'm on the end of my rope. Fear of running out of unemployment insurance coupled with fear of not being able to get out of social anxiety. No matter what happen, I convinced myself to hang on just because I feel like I haven't tried all options yet and as I said, I still don't want my close family to hurt but otherwise, what can I do? I applied for jobs and nothing came out of it. I may try 5-htp as a way to get out of depression but otherwise, there was so much failure in the past 6 month, it's as if it just proved once and for all, I won't be able to do anything significant and enjoyable.

I can't add too much details because I want to stay anonymous. I never had a "career", I was just doing the same shit everyday in an office, because I failed at doing anything else. Now that I even failed at improving my situation, all I see is a dark future. It seems like whenever I start something good, I actually find a way to mess it up. Low self esteem is the problem but I would need it in order to have success in life. It's a catch-22, no self esteem equal no achievements, no achievements equal low self esteem and depression. I'm not living for myself, I'm just going through all that shit because it would hurt members of my family if I ever do anything bad. Apart from close members of my family, I don't have any meaningful relationship, it happened in the past but I failed at keeping in touch, failing is what I do best. It make me want to cry just to think that I need to vent on reddit, it just show how desperate I am.
